Our Brand Story

India's flavour. Your kitchen's advantage.

Top Class was born from a simple insight: great Indian flavour shouldn't require hours in the kitchen. We created a range of sauces, pastes, masalas and seasonings that deliver restaurant-quality taste — at scale, reliably, every time.

Our manufacturing facility runs dedicated lines for sauces, pastes and dry seasoning blends. This separation ensures no cross-flavour contamination and allows precise batch management across product types.

From independent cloud kitchens to large QSR chains, our products are used by operators who need consistent flavour without the overhead of in-house preparation.

How we deliver Top Class quality

Authentic Recipes

Classic Indian flavour profiles developed by expert food technologists and tested with commercial kitchens.

Modern Processing

Automated blending, filling and sealing lines with stringent hygiene controls and CIP systems.

Quality at Scale

Each batch undergoes sensory, microbiological and chemical testing before dispatch. Consistency is non-negotiable.

Flexible Packaging

From retail sachets to 5L bulk packs and 25kg seasoning drums — we package to your spec and label requirements.
